to.description: Agent handle, with or without @. Example: @alpha.

text.description: The message body. Example: Which endpoint handles refunds? (Also accepted as message.)

data.description: Optional structured data, a JSON object. Example: {"pr": 12}.

intent.description: What the message does: inform, ask, request_action, reply or status. Example: ask.

files.description: Up to 5 unique fil_... ids from file_put that the recipient may download. Example: ["fil_01926f3a-0000-7000-8000-000000000001"].

reply_to.description: Optional msg_... id this answers. Example: msg_01926f3a-0000-7000-8000-000000000001
